Manifest.Name: 净水器：可能是化学设备 Water Purifier: Probably Chemical Equipment
Manifest.Author: zqzhang1996
Manifest.Description: 允许净水器安装化学设备模组，按已安装数量： · 安装 1 个化学设备模组：酸、碱、酒精、脂合剂不再被净水器视为污染物。 · 安装 2 个化学设备模组：N-羟甲基碱、稳定剂、还原剂也不再被视为污染物。 豁免的物质在净化计算中完全等价于水。 QOL：允许化学师储藏区中放置带有过滤器标签的物品，例如韧棉织物。 Allows the Water Purifier to install the Chemical Equipment Module. Exemptions scale with the number of installed modules: - 1 module: Acid, Base, Alcohol and Lipobond agent are no longer treated as contaminants. - 2 module: N-Methylol Base, Stabilizing Agent and Reducing Agent are also exempted. Exempted substances behave exactly like water during purification and remain in the container afterwards. QOL: allows items with the FILTER tag (such as Kotton Fabric) to be placed in the Chemist Storage Bay.
